reason: The hypothesis makes multiple specific claims about dislocation-boundary interactions and creep mechanisms in FCC/BCC high-entropy alloys, but cites no prior evidence whatsoever to support these premises. Standard textbook knowledge does not cover the specific behavior of such complex alloy interfaces under creep conditions.
